en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: Refines session defaults and minute-by-minute choices. Improves reminder scheduling and recovery after manual sessions. Please check value selection, progress and reminders.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 调整默认选项，细化逐分钟时间选择，改进手动操作后的提醒排程与运行恢复。请检查数值选择、运行进度和提醒表现。
